purpose: Prevent false integrity failures when the same committed text is checked out with LF or CRLF on Linux and Windows while preserving the pre-first-forecast Windows frozen protocol SHA identity.
text_normalization: normalize CRLF and CR to logical LF
serialize every logical line ending as CRLF before SHA256
text_scope: text governance artifacts participating in SHA chains

binary_scope.rule: Private visual screenshots and other binary evidence remain raw-byte SHA256; no EOL normalization applies.

migration_rule: V1.6 and later records use this method. Historical pre-v1.6 selftest hashes retain their original recorded semantics and are not rewritten.
